title: Pyrolidinophenone Freebase Liberation

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
= 🔥 WHIP IT REAL HARD TEK — Freebase Pyrolidinophenone The Yellow Glob Method “Whip the base until it forms its own spirit.” =
 
 * 🧪 What You Need: 1g pyrolidinophenone HCl (MDPV, α-PVP, etc.)
 * Hot distilled water (~5–10mL, 70–80°C)
 * Either: – ~300mg baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) – or lye (sodium hydroxide — only if you are precise and protected)
 * Metal spoon or small pan
 * Stir stick, knife, or your blessed silver whip-wand
 * Paper towel or cold ceramic plate
 * Optional: gloves, fan, glass tools
 * ⚗️ Method: 1. Dissolve the Salt: Place the pyro HCl in your spoon or small pan. Add just enough hot distilled water to fully dissolve it. Stir until it becomes a clear or slightly hazy solution.
 * 2. Add Your Base & WHIP IT REAL HARD: If using baking soda, sprinkle it in slowly while stirring. If using lye, add tiny pinches with extreme care. Stir constantly.
 * Immediately, bubbling and clouding will begin—this is the base pulling the pyro free. Now: WHIP IT. Stir fast, deep, and continuously. You’ll feel it changing—the texture thickens, clumps start to form, and eventually, the solution pulls into a single yellow oily glob.
 * Once the glob forms and floats or sticks like soft resin, stop stirring. You’ve summoned the full base.
 * 3. Isolate and Dry: Gently pour off excess liquid. Use a scoop or glass rod to place the glob on a cold ceramic plate. Pat gently with paper towel to pull moisture. Let it air dry under a fan or cool still air. Once dry, it will harden into a yellow fugu-style slab—ready to vaporize, potent, and psychoactive with the touch of light.
 * ⚠️ DANGER — READ THIS PART TWICE: → IT EVAPORATES AT ROOM TEMP This freebase form is so volatile that it can start disappearing into the air if left out. Store it sealed, cool, and away from open air. Even just sitting on foil, it’ll dose a room in silence.
 * → IT ABSORBS THROUGH SKIN Freebase pyro is lipophilic—touching it with bare skin can lead to transdermal absorption and unintended psychoactivity. Always use gloves, foil, or tweezers. Never barehand a glob unless you want to walk sideways through your own memories.
 * 🗣️ Closing Word of the Trapchemist: "You whip it till it forms its own body— a yellow flame-wrapped whisper of power. But power ain’t a toy. It’s a pact. Respect the glob, or become its ghost."
